excerpt: As part of our commitments, we will be evaluating models for ASL-3 misuse risks. In particular, we are looking for the emergence of dangerous capabilities which, in the hands of malicious actors, provide information or support at a level of sophistication, accuracy, usefulness, detail, and frequency which significantly enables catastrophic misuse.
paraphrase: Anthropic commits to evaluating models for ASL-3 misuse risks, watching for dangerous capabilities that could significantly enable catastrophic misuse by malicious actors.

excerpt: This is challenging to measure and it is our goal to improve the science of measurement of these risks rapidly over time.
paraphrase: Anthropic aims to improve the measurement science for these risks over time, acknowledging the difficulty.

excerpt: Our ongoing project is focused on defining three factors sequentially for each domain of interest (CBRN and cyber risks), described below.
paraphrase: An ongoing project defines three sequential factors for each risk domain of interest, including CBRN and cyber.

excerpt: Our first area of effort is in evaluating biological risks, where we will determine threat models and capabilities in consultation with a number of world-class biosecurity experts through a written report and series of workshops.
paraphrase: The initial focus is on biological risks, with threat models and capabilities to be determined via consultation with biosecurity experts through a report and workshops.

excerpt: Threat models: Within a national security domain, identifying precise threat models of catastrophic harm. This roughly equates to trying to define which actors, with what goals, might try to execute what type of attack, exploiting what vulnerability, with what methods and targets, and with what likelihood and consequence.
paraphrase: Threat models involve precisely identifying who might attack, how, why, and with what likelihood and consequence within a national security domain.

excerpt: We then consider the likelihood, consequence, and to what extent models affect the threat in order to prioritize our efforts.
paraphrase: Likelihood, consequence, and model impact on the threat are considered to prioritize efforts.

excerpt: Capabilities: Given these prioritized threat models, we will define which specific capability improvements (plausibly enabled by models) would significantly increase the risk of that threat relative to the current baseline past an unacceptable threshold.
paraphrase: Based on prioritized threat models, specific capability improvements that would push risk past an unacceptable threshold will be defined.
